counting: Full native gates have 81 registered tests each; sanitizer gates have 31 affected registered tests each. R2.4 has three logical suites with 26 subcases. WorkerTools has 20 subcases after two additional regressions; subcases are not separate suites.
limitations: The 31 ASan registrations are the original affected-suite selection, not a claim that all 81 registrations were run under ASan locally.
The completed event probe is one diagnostic execution and does not independently satisfy the 31-item gate.
Earlier failures, timeouts and interrupted runs remain immutable evidence; a later successful run does not prove they were solely environmental.
External candidate sources and successful compilation are preparation only; their tests are NOT_RUN and they do not contribute to acceptance.
